proof.title: The complete customer lifecycle
proof.summary: From the first opt-in to installation, warranty, reviews, and referrals.
steps: Ad opt-in flows into GoHighLevel, followed by an instant confirmation SMS.
Setter qualification call, then sales appointment booking.
Appointment reminders one day before and one hour before.
Automated email and SMS follow-up on open quotes.
Newsletter-style campaigns for ghosted leads. A reply re-notifies the setter or rep for a human handoff.
Post-purchase thank-you, install scheduling, and day-before and hour-before reminders.
Warranty and maintenance communications, review requests, and a referral program.
Online form, assessment visit, qualification, then service appointment.
bullets: Channels: email, SMS, and on-page forms connected to the CRM.
Lifecycle testing focused on phrasing, tone, and GIFs to revive ghosted leads. A/B testing was primarily ad-side.
